passages.provision_quote: A male, based on a student's biological sex at birth in accordance with the student's genetics and reproductive biology, may not participate on an athletic team or sport designated under this section as being a female, women's, or girls' athletic team or sport.
passages.note: Enrolled act text; operative clause bars biological males from girls' teams.
King voted Yea on Roll Call 402, overriding the veto of the single-subject HEA 1041.
passages.tally_quote: Yea 67 Participation in school sports. (2022) Nay 28 Excused 5 Not Voting 0

passages.note: Bill details page lists King as a co-author of the bill as filed.
passages.actor_quote: Co-Authored by: Rep. Chris Jeter, Rep. Joanna King, Rep. Robert Heaton.

rows.reasoning: King co-authored HB 1041 (2022) and voted Yea on Roll Call 402 to override the governor's veto of this single-subject bill, whose operative text bars a person based on biological sex at birth from participating on a female, women's, or girls' team, matching the rung that would 'require transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth.'
